simple.meaning: מַחֲבַת (machăbath) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a pan for baking in.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 2:5. The surrounding context includes family line, offering, altar, Torah, priesthood, city.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H4227. machabath מַחֲבַת noun feminine flat plate, pan, or griddle for baking , only P and late; absolute ׳מ Lev 2:5 2 t.; מַחֲבַ֑ת 7:9 ; construct מַחֲבַת Ezek 4:3 ; — 1 used in preparing the (baken) mincha , preceded by עַלֿ Lev 2:5 ; 6:14 ; 7:9 (all P), compare 1Chr 23:29 . 2 ׳מ בַּרְזֶל Ezek 4:3 a plate of iron , signifying an iron wall, in prediction of siege of city. חָגָּא חָג, see below חגּגּ . חגּב (√ of following; meaning dubious; possibly compare Arabic prevent, intervene, hide , that which veils, conceals, hides ; Syriac shrine ; hence locusts as concealing the sky?).
